occupation_data.rationale: Local registry workflows are foundational to CI/CD pipelines and air-gapped enterprise deployments; pushing versioned images to an internal registry is standard DevOps practice

notes: The local registry pattern (registry:2) is the canonical approach for private Docker image hosting. The task requires the agent to understand the full docker build → tag → push → pull workflow and the compose 'image:' vs 'build:' distinction.
